Skipped: side-wall siding (return not visible). Tint lift (2026-10-02): paint tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k); brick tints converted to target / kit colour. Wall charcoal 7a7570 (lum 0.18), dark panel garage via glazed-garage plus garagePanels, brown base to 2.7 m. Storey count left at the roll value (4); ~3 window rows over the garage.
